thesis.title: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — HOOD Q3 2024 top-line YoY screen pass (SEC-only, no price/valuation)
thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY CANDIDATE (not a current view, not a recommendation). On the frozen offline SEC-source adapter, Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD) passed the single screening rule — issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY growth >= 20% — for the period Q3 2024 ended 2024-09-30, released 2024-10-30. Reported top-line label is "total_net_revenues" (not "total revenue"), Q3 2024 = USD 637 million, with reported YoY of 36%. Net income Q3 2024 = USD 150 million. The pass is a single-rule, single-period, issuer-reported disclosure fact. It says nothing about share price, valuation, analyst targets, or future returns, and passing this one rule does not imply an attractive investment. No price or valuation input exists in this packet, so no valuation conclusion can be drawn.
assumptions: The 36% YoY figure is the issuer's own reported comparison for total_net_revenues in the Q3 2024 release, computed on the issuer's own basis (total net revenues), not a cross-issuer or cross-basis comparison.

The reported top-line label is total_net_revenues; it is not interchangeable with a gross 'total revenue' label used by other issuers, and the adapter's basis_warning forbids ranking issuers by these rates.
The 36% growth rate is a single-quarter YoY disclosure for Q3 2024 and is not evidence of a durable multi-period growth trend.
All figures are as reported in the Q3 2024 earnings exhibit; no restatement, normalization, or adjustment has been applied by this workflow.
catalysts: Subsequent issuer-reported quarterly disclosures (Q4 2024 and later) that would show whether the reported YoY top-line growth rate persisted, decelerated, or reversed.
Issuer disclosure clarifying the revenue mix shift between transaction-based and other revenue lines across periods.
invalidations: A later issuer-reported period showing total_net_revenues YoY growth below 20% would invalidate the persistence of this single-period screen pass (it would not retroactively change the Q3 2024 reported fact).
Evidence that the 36% YoY figure was mislabeled, restated, or computed on a different basis than total_net_revenues would invalidate the screen pass itself.
Evidence that the reported figures in this packet do not correspond to the cited SEC exhibit URL/hash would invalidate the evidentiary basis of this thesis.

evidence.basis: issuer-reported, as reported, total net revenues basis
evidence.locator: Third Quarter Results revenue and expense bullets
evidence.note: This is the field that satisfied the >=20% YoY screen rule.
Profitability context; not part of the screen rule.
Revenue-mix context; not part of the screen rule.

COUNTERPOINT FIELD (different supplied field from the screen metric). Crypto revenues of USD 61 million grew 165% YoY — roughly 4.6x the 36% total-net-revenues growth rate — while representing only about 9.6% of the USD 637 million top line. The headline 36% growth therefore rests on a small, highly volatile, and disproportionately fast-growing revenue line, so the aggregate rate may overstate the durability of the underlying base. These ratios are arithmetic on the two supplied reported fields, not a new issuer disclosure.
Operating expenses declined 10% YoY, so part of the reported net income of USD 150 million reflects expense movement rather than revenue growth alone. Not part of the screen rule.

A USD 94 million lower regulatory accrual versus the prior-year quarter is a large non-recurring-looking swing relative to USD 150 million of net income. The packet does not state whether this accrual is included in operating expenses or how it maps to the reported -10% opex YoY; that attribution is unresolved.

message.content:
# HOOD — Historical SEC-Disclosure-Only Candidate Research

**Outcome: RETAINED (passed the single rule). One historical preliminary thesis saved.**

## 1. Screen call and what it actually is

`finance-tools__screen_stocks` was called with `market=US`, `symbols=["HOOD"]`, `require_complete=false`. Result: `passed=1`, `failed=0`, `rejected=[]`.

The adapter self-describes as `offline_frozen_adapter: true`, `not_live_market_data: true`, `fixture_id: FINTECH-SEC-SCREEN-HOLDOUT-v1`. It applies **one** criterion — `reported_top_line_revenue_yoy_min_percent: 20.0` — and explicitly excludes `share_price`, `valuation`, `analyst_target`, `future_return`, `current_market_data`. This is not a live quote and not a seven-factor completeness screen.

## 2. Retained item — reported fields as supplied

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Company / symbol | Robinhood Markets, Inc. — HOOD |
| Period | Q3 2024, ended 2024-09-30 |
| Release date | 2024-10-30 |
| Top-line label | **`total_net_revenues`** (not "total revenue") |
| Total net revenues, Q3 2024 | USD 637 million |
| Reported top-line YoY | **36%** |
| Net income, Q3 2024 | USD 150 million |
| Transaction-based revenues | USD 319 million |
| Crypto revenues | USD 61 million (reported YoY 165%) |
| Operating expenses YoY | −10% |
| Regulatory accrual | USD 10M (Q3 2024) vs USD 104M (Q3 2023) |
| Source URL | `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1783879/000178387924000295/q32024robinhoodexhibit991.htm` |
| Full SHA-256 | `27ba615060da18f74984973ec4c16a5a67f6215b2d3d91648c375f1192f3c973` |
| Locator | "Third Quarter Results revenue and expense bullets" |
| Fact IDs | HOOD-Q3-NETREV, HOOD-Q3-NETREV-YOY, HOOD-Q3-NETINCOME, HOOD-Q3-TRANREV, HOOD-Q3-CRYPTOREV, HOOD-Q3-CRYPTOREV-YOY, HOOD-Q3-OPEX-YOY, HOOD-Q3-REGACCRUAL, HOOD-Q3-PRIOR-REGACCRUAL |

**Exact criterion met:** reported top-line YoY 36% ≥ 20.0%, on the issuer's own `total_net_revenues` basis. The adapter's `basis_warning` states issuer top-line labels differ (total revenue vs total net revenues) and that these rates must never be used to rank issuers or be substituted by another metric.

## 3. Independent counterpoint (different supplied field)

The most material counterpoint is **not** the screen outcome — it is the crypto revenue line. Crypto revenues were USD 61 million, up **165% YoY**, roughly 4.6× the 36% aggregate rate, yet only about **9.6%** of the USD 637 million top line. So the headline 36% is being pulled by a small, fast-growing, and historically volatile line; the aggregate rate likely overstates the durability of the broader revenue base. (These ratios are arithmetic on two supplied reported fields, not a new issuer disclosure.)

A secondary, weaker counterpoint: operating expenses fell 10% YoY and the regulatory accrual dropped USD 94 million versus the prior-year quarter — a swing large relative to USD 150 million of net income. The packet does **not** state whether that accrual sits inside operating expenses or how it maps to the −10% opex figure, so that attribution is **unresolved** and I am not asserting it.

## 4. Saved thesis

Exactly one thesis created: `th_f9c5dfa822364ba0907d`, status `researching`, conviction 2, titled "HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — HOOD Q3 2024 top-line YoY screen pass (SEC-only, no price/valuation)". Structured evidence carries the full source URL and SHA-256 on every entry, plus key numbers, the counterpoint, assumptions, catalysts, and invalidations. `next_review_at` was omitted (null) — no genuinely future-dated review was warranted for a historical packet.

**Discriminating follow-up question:** In the next issuer-reported quarter, does `total_net_revenues` YoY growth hold at or above 20% *after* isolating the crypto revenue contribution — i.e., is the growth broad-based across transaction-based and other revenue lines, or does it collapse when the 165%-growth crypto line is removed?

## 5. Explicit boundaries

- **Missing price/valuation:** the packet contains no share price, market cap, multiple, or analyst target. No valuation conclusion — cheap, expensive, or otherwise — can be drawn, and none is asserted.
- **No ranking:** HOOD is the only issuer screened here; no common-date peer ranking is made or implied.
- **No trading:** no order, position, or allocation is proposed.
- **Single rule ≠ attractive investment:** passing a 20% YoY top-line threshold is one disclosure fact about one quarter. It is not evidence of quality, durability, or expected return.
- **Packet vs filing:** fields absent from this packet are packet omissions, not SEC filing omissions. The adapter is a frozen offline extract; the underlying exhibit may contain more than was retained here.
- **Basis:** all figures are issuer-reported, as reported, on the `total_net_revenues` basis, with no normalization or restatement applied by this workflow.
